notes.title: Special deal for fans of Studio Fizbin: Save now on “Minute of Islands”
notes.content:
Minute of Islands is the newest game by Studio Fizbin, the makers of The Inner World I and II. It’s their first puzzle platforming game and brings Studio Fizbin’s signature comic-book art style to vivid life. 

You can now visit the sprawling islands and the alien labyrinths below them while guiding  young mechanic Mo on her quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse. And the best thing is: If you already own one of the Inner World games on Steam, you get 10% off! 

This deal runs untill July 26th 10:00 PST. Just head over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049710/Minute_of_Islands/]Minute of Islands’ Steam page[/url] to buy the game, the special discount will be added in the Steam shopping cart.

[previewyoutube=V6V7AZCRYBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Story[/b]

You are Mo, a skilled tinkerer, living with her family on a pastoral archipelago, once inhabited by an ancient race of inscrutable giants. Their otherworldly but vital machines, festering in the underbellies of the islands, must be kept going or an ever-present threat will swallow all. 

The islands are engulfed in clouds of poisonous spores. The only thing keeping them inhabitable are mysterious antennas built when the giants still lived on the surface alongside people. But the machines are now failing, and only one person can repair them: Mo and her versatile Omni Switch.

Driven to protect her family and friends, Mo sets out on a quest to save her world. But, as she uncovers the truth of the islands and the giants that live below the surface, she begins to learn that her focus and ambition may not always be the assets she believes them to be. Haunted by memories, Mo’s journey of the islands of her home becomes a trip into the depths of her subconscious.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Wield the powerful Omni Switch throughout story-based environmental puzzles and platform gameplay to regain control over the giants’ machines.
[*] Face the dark truth beneath the islands’ surfaces and unravel an emotional poetic story, narrated by actress Megan Gay.
[*] Explore a fantastic handcrafted world across multiple unique islands, meet curious characters and creatures, and uncover the archipelago’s secrets.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049710/Minute_of_Islands/
